newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures slip at close with Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures slip at close with Tokyo.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures lost ground on Monday after a downward correction on Tokyo stocks encouraged small-scale profit-taking.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 115 points weaker at 20,095. Volume was a relatively low 12,695 lots.
In morning trade, the contract had briefly moved up to the top of its current trading range at 21,300.

Dealers said the reversal of last week's strong run upwards on the Tokyo stock market had helped prevent the futures market from moving higher. The 225-issue Nikkei average closed 135.96 points down at 21,065.08.
